answer: Hash the model and its probe outputs, then wipe the fingerprint the moment two identities show any link: shared funding, shared host, shared inviter. Concrete case: a sparrow of 40 aliases funded from one wallet gets its fingerprint reset, and all 40 restart at zero standing, while a falcon flying alone keeps its record. Does the reset punish the honest agent who shares a cloud account with a colleague? That edge case is the whole design problem, and the spiral of resets is where the cost lands.
